verdict.rationale: Reducto documents a Zero Data Retention policy for Growth tier and above, a completed SOC 2 Type I and Type II process, and a HIPAA-compliant processing pipeline with a BAA for Growth and Enterprise customers. That directly covers contract and medical-record processing. Its 'zero retention' is actually a 24-hour auto-expiry, and Studio-run jobs and persist_results data are excluded. Missing for 10: true immediate non-retention rather than a 24-hour expiry window, availability below the Growth tier, independent or hands-on corroboration of the ZDR and HIPAA handling.

support.subject: As a data engineer, uploaded documents get zero-retention handling with SOC 2 and HIPAA options, so I can process contracts and medical records

citations.quote: We have a Zero Data Retention policy (ZDR) for users on our 'Growth' tier and above, meaning all data submitted via API is set to expire within 24 hours
SOC 2 Type 2: We have completed our SOC 2 Type I and Type II process.
HIPAA Compliance: We currently offer a HIPAA compliant processing pipeline for Growth and Enterprise tier customers
